wikitext: [[File:A Mimikyu Bedtime Story.png|thumb|350px|A Mimikyu Bedtime Story]] '''A Mimikyu Bedtime Story''' (Japanese: '''おねむりストーリー ミミッキュ''' ''A {{tt|Mimikkyu|Mimikyu}} Sleeping Story'') is a 1-minute {{pkmn|animation|animated}} short based on [[Pokémon Sleep]]. It was released on the official Pokémon [[YouTube]] channels and {{pkmn|social media}} accounts on October 24, 2024. It was released as a promotion for the Halloween event and accompanied by an in-game event making it easier to encounter {{p|Mimikyu}} and also a distibution of a Mimikyu {{Sleep|Incense}}. ==Blurb== Spooky dreams don’t have to be scary! And just like Mimikyu’s disguise, this sleepy story is nothing to be afraid of. 🤗 ==Plot== A {{p|Mimikyu}} stumbles upon a clearing where {{Sleep|Snorlax}} is sleeping. A {{p|Pikachu}} wearing a [[Halloween]] hat is decorating the clearing for Halloween, with {{wp|Jack-o'-lantern}}s and various gift boxes. While Pikachu fixes the boxes as a {{p|Cubone}} spies on it from behind a tree, Mimikyu approaches a Pikachu-shaped Jack-o'-lantern and admires it. Pikachu notices Mimikyu and runs up to it to say hello, but Mimikyu runs away. A chase ensues, ending when both Pikachu and Mimikyu end up in the gift boxes. Mimikyu's {{a|disguise}} gets {{fd|Mimikyu|busted}}, and Pikachu helps fix it. Mimikyu now follows Pikachu and the two of them prepare another Jack-o'-lantern with {{Sleep|Candy|candies}}. Afterwards, Pikachu, Mimikyu, and Snorlax eat {{b|Grepa}} and [[Wiki Berry|Wiki Berries]] together. Later, a {{p|Clefairy}} is resting near a sleeping Snorlax, as Pikachu and Mimikyu also start to drowse off. Mimikyu, feeling content, yawns drifts off to sleep. The scene changes to Mimikyu's "[[Sleep style|Wanna-Curl-Up Sleep]]" style being recorded in the Sleep Style Dex. ==Characters== ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Snorlax}} ([[Snorlax (Sleep)|Sleep]]) * {{p|Pikachu}} (Halloween cap) * {{p|Mimikyu}} * {{p|Cubone}} * {{p|Clefairy}} ==Cast== {{cast/h|Yellow}} {{cast|Paldea|Snorlax (Pokémon)|disp=Snorlax|Katsuyuki Konishi|Kabigon|Katsuyuki Konishi|カビゴン|小西克幸|top=yes}} {{cast|Paldea|Clefairy (Pokémon)|disp=Clefairy|Mayumi Iizuka|Pippi|Mayumi Iizuka|ピッピ|飯塚雅弓}} {{cast|Paldea|Mimikyu (Pokémon)|disp=Mimikyu|Daisuke Namikawa|Mimikkyu|Daisuke Namikawa|ミミッキュ |浪川大輔}} {{cast|Paldea|Pikachu (Pokémon)|disp=Pikachu|Ikue Otani|Pikachu|Ikue Otani|ピカチュウ|大谷育江|bottom=yes}} |} ==Staff== {| class="credits-table roundtable" style="background: #{{Electric color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{Ghost color}}" |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" ! class="roundytl" width="24%" | Director / Script / Storyboards | class="roundytr" width="38%" | * Yoshimitsu Saito |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" !
